facts.statement: freerealms.com hosted a French-language video guide in which Arbitre Ruby introduces the game to players.
facts.quote: Voila une vidéo d'Arbitre Ruby pour vous parler du jeu!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a French-language freerealms.com page introducing a video guide by 'Arbitre Ruby' (Referee Ruby), described as one of the game's best referees who helps players having problems while walking around with her tiger. The page gives no game mechanics, quest, item or price data. The article text is mostly a short intro and site boilerplate.
